description:
FI32 Semi-Rigid Insulation is a versatile glasswool board and
roll insulation engineered for thermal and acoustic performance in HVAC and
industrial systems. Designed for internal lining of sheet metal air conditioning
ductwork, it is also widely used on storage tanks, process vessels, plant rooms,
and acoustic baffles. Manufactured from up to 80% recycled glass with an FBS-1
bio-soluble formulation, it is available unfaced or factory-laminated with
Sisalation Heavy Duty Perforated foil, Black Matt Facing, or Vapastop 883.

Nominal density of 32 kg/m³ providing superior structural
rigidity and acoustic absorption

Excellent sound absorption with NRC values
up to 1.00 in ductwork and plant rooms

Thermal conductivity of 0.032 W/m·K
at 23°C

Available unfaced or with Vapastop 883, Sisalation HDP foil, or Black
Matt Facing
Non-combustible glasswool substrate compliant with AS 1530.1
Manufactured in Australia from up to 80% recycled glass

Accommodates flat
and curved surfaces on tanks and vessels

Certified under CodeMark Certificate
of Conformity CM 30006

Biosoluble safe-to-use FBS-1 formulation with low VOC
emissions

install:
Clean
internal sheet metal duct or vessel surface ensuring it is free of oil and
dust

Cut FI32 sheets or rolls accurately to fit internal duct dimensions
using a sharp insulation knife

Apply approved water-based or solvent-based
duct liner adhesive covering 100% of the metal surface

Press FI32 firmly into
the wet adhesive with facing material exposed to the air stream

Fasten with
mechanical weld pins or grip nails at recommended spacings per AS 4254

Seal
all leading edges, transverse joints, and longitudinal seams with Vapastop 883
tape or edge-seal mastic

For curved vessels or tanks, wrap sheets or rolls
tightly and secure with metal banding straps

rag_summary:
Fletcher FI32 Semi-Rigid
Insulation is a 32 kg/m³ high-density glasswool board and roll insulation
engineered for internal HVAC duct lining and industrial vessel lagging.
Delivering superior sound absorption (NRC up to 1.00) and thermal conductivity
of 0.032 W/m·K, it is available unfaced or with Sisalation HDP perforated foil,
Black Matt Facing, or Vapastop 883 vapour barrier. CodeMark certified (CM 30006)

transfer in commercial ductwork and plant rooms.

description:
FI24 Flexible Ductliner is a lightweight, flexible glasswool
internal liner specifically developed for air conditioning ductwork and
mechanical equipment. Possessing the high resiliency of a semi-rigid board while
retaining sufficient flexibility for roll form handling, it is designed for use
with automated sheet metal cutting and coil line duct-making machinery. It
provides thermal performance and acoustic attenuation to reduce fan roar and air
turbulence within HVAC systems.

rag_summary:

Ductliner is a 24 kg/m³ flexible glasswool internal duct lining roll

description:
Pink Thermal Slab is a high-performance commercial insulation
board consisting of a semi-rigid glasswool slab factory-laminated with a
Sisalation reflective foil laminate on one side. Engineered for commercial
concrete under-slab soffits, concrete roofs, floors, and plant room walls, it
controls temperature fluctuations and dampens structural and airborne noise.
Achieving an AS 5637.1 Group 1 NCC fire classification for ceiling linings and
CodeMark certification, it satisfies thermal performance, acoustic absorption,
and strict non-combustibility requirements.

description:
Fletcher Protect Party Wall Stonewool Batts and Blankets are
non-combustible mineral wool insulation products engineered to provide passive
fire protection in party and separating wall systems between adjacent tenancies
in NCC Class 1 and Class 10 buildings. Manufactured from molten volcanic rock
(basalt) and recycled blast furnace slag, they provide exceptional resistance to
shrinkage under extreme fire temperatures up to 1000°C. They are designed to
compress-fill vertical joints, service penetrations, and top-of-wall junctions
beneath roof membranes to prevent flame and hot gas bypass.

description:
Permastop Building Blanket is a reflective glasswool insulation

bio-soluble glasswool bonded to light, medium, or heavy-duty aluminium foil with
an anti-glare finish, it reflects radiant heat while dramatically reducing rain
impact drumming noise. Available in R-values from R1.3 to R3.6 (including an
industry-leading R3.6 in 130mm), it satisfies NCC requirements and bushfire
ratings up to BAL-40.

description:
Sisalation Vapawrap Residential Wall Wrap is a lightweight,
flexible Class 4 vapour-permeable wall wrap engineered for residential timber
and steel-framed homes, particularly in temperate and colder climate zones
(Zones 2 to 8). Constructed from a micro-porous breathable film laminated
between two layers of mould- and shrink-resistant spun-bonded polyolefin, it
allows internal moisture vapour to escape while acting as a barrier to liquid
water, wind, and dust. Available with up to 30 days (VP4-30) or 90 days (VP4-90)
UV resistance, it protects the structural frame and maximizes bulk insulation
efficiency.

description:
Sisalation Vapawrap Vapour Permeable Metal Roof is a synthetic,

microporous water-resistant film sandwiched between two layers of mould- and
shrink-resistant spun-bonded polyolefin, it provides superior heat shrink
resistance compared to traditional polymer-weave membranes under hot metal
decks. It allows water vapour to escape from roof cavities while functioning as
an air and liquid water barrier that safely drains condensation into gutters.

spun-bonded polyolefin non-woven layers sandwiching a microporous core, it
delivers outstanding heat-shrink resistance to remain taut beneath hot metal
decks. Allowing moisture vapour to vent freely while preventing water leaks and
drafts, it complies with AS/NZS 4200.1, AS 1530.2 (Flammability Index ≤ 5), and
AS 3959 (up to BAL-40) to mitigate roof condensation.

foil with flame-retardant adhesives, it delivers exceptional tear and puncture

building R-values.

rag_summary:
Sisalation Tuff Wrap and Multipurpose Sarking (Sisalation 497 / 456 EHD) is an
extra-tough reflective foil building membrane manufactured by Fletcher
Insulation. Built with woven polymer (polyweave) reinforcement laminated to pure

core) laminated between reflective aluminium foil layers with an anti-glare
coating, it reflects up to 95% of radiant heat. Engineered for steel and
timber-framed roofs and walls in residential, commercial, shed, and double-brick
applications, it features a 150mm foil overlap flap for seamless jointing and
complies with NCC thermal break requirements.

rag_summary:
Sisalation Foam Cell and Bubble Cell is an Extra Heavy
Duty 3-in-1 reflective insulation, thermal break, and Class 2 vapour barrier
composite manufactured by Fletcher Insulation. Built with an 8.4mm closed-cell
cross-linked foam core (R0.20 to R0.25) or 4.0mm bubble core laminated between
aluminium foil faces with an anti-glare finish and a 150mm overlap flap, it
reflects up to 95% of radiant heat while preventing thermal bridging on steel
studs. Tested to AS 5637.1 (Group 2 rating for Multipurpose) and compliant with
AS 3959 up to BAL-40, it is ideal for steel-framed roofs, walls, and sheds.

description:
supaBATT is a high-density, rigid glasswool external wall
insulation board engineered specifically to enhance the thermal performance of
brick veneer walls in response to NCC 2022 7-star energy efficiency standards.
Available unfaced or pre-faced with a Class 4 vapour-permeable membrane
(supaBATT VP4), it is installed externally onto timber or steel studs before
brickwork is laid. By insulating over the exterior face of framing, it
eliminates thermal bridging, controls moisture vapour transfer, and boosts total
wall system R-values.

rag_summary:
Fletcher supaBATT is a rigid, high-density glasswool board designed for
installation onto the exterior face of timber or steel studs in brick veneer
construction. Engineered to help builders achieve 7-star NatHERS energy
compliance under NCC 2022, it provides continuous external insulation that
eliminates stud thermal bridging. Available plain or factory-laminated with a
Class 4 vapour-permeable membrane (supaBATT VP4), it combines non-combustible
bulk thermal resistance (AS 1530.1) with condensation management, backed by a
Consumer Lifetime Warranty.
